book.name: XHUN
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ CHUSBꞌALTETZ U JESUUS ITZꞌIBꞌA U XHAN Unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Xhun tiꞌ u Jesús

content: Ech u Jesús u toj u uuvaeꞌ
As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Tan ech ineꞌ echeꞌ u jikla toj u uuvaeꞌ. As ech vunBꞌaaleꞌ echeꞌ umaj uxhchil uvaꞌ ni josqꞌin u uuvaeꞌ.
As abꞌiste viqꞌabꞌ u uuvaeꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ la taqꞌ ivatz, as la itzokꞌ veꞌt el vunBꞌaaleꞌ. Pet ech koj unqꞌa iqꞌabꞌeꞌ uveꞌ la taqꞌ ivatz, tan la ijosqꞌi veꞌt Aak, aqꞌal uvaꞌ nimal ivatz la taqꞌ veꞌteꞌ.
As ech kat vulbꞌe ex, tan kat unjosqꞌi veꞌt vetaanxelaleꞌ taꞌn vunyoleꞌ uveꞌ kat val sete.

As tuk chit voksa vaama setiꞌ tiꞌ chit ibꞌeneꞌ. Echabꞌataj etoksat etaama sviꞌ tiꞌ chit ibꞌeneꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ la ebꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ umaj iqꞌabꞌ u uuvaeꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ atoꞌk tiꞌ u tojeꞌ, tan yeꞌ la uch taqꞌat ivatz sijunal. As echat ex, tan asoj yeꞌ la etoksa etaama sviꞌ, as yeꞌxhkam la etxꞌol ebꞌanat sejunal.

As ineꞌ taꞌ u toj u uuvaeꞌ. As exeꞌ viqꞌabꞌeꞌ. As jankꞌal ex uvaꞌ la etoksa etaama sviꞌ bꞌenameen as la voksa vaama setiꞌ unpajte. As nimal chit veꞌt bꞌaꞌnil la ebꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ nibꞌan u uuvaeꞌ tul nivatzin tzeꞌ. Pet asoj yeꞌ la etoksa etaama sviꞌ, as yeꞌxhkam chit la etxꞌol ebꞌanat sejunal.
Abꞌil uveꞌ yeꞌ la ichabꞌa toksat taama sviꞌ as la eesal el echeꞌ teesal el umaj iqꞌabꞌ u uuvaeꞌ. As tul la tzaji, as la molpi. As la tzꞌeꞌsal veꞌt tu u xamaleꞌ.
Asoj la etoksa etaama sviꞌ as la atin unqꞌa unyoleꞌ sekꞌuꞌl bꞌenameen tiꞌ ebꞌanat unqꞌa bꞌaꞌneꞌ. As ejajtaj sve kam u bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal etaama. As la chit unbꞌaneꞌ,
tan ech la okkat iqꞌii vunBꞌaaleꞌ. As ech ekꞌuchateꞌ uvaꞌ ex niman vetz tiꞌ ebꞌanat u bꞌaꞌneꞌ echeꞌ nibꞌan u uuvaeꞌ tul ni taqꞌ tzeꞌ ivatz.
Tan xoꞌn in te vunBꞌaaleꞌ. As echat nunbꞌan unpajte, tan xoꞌn ex sve. As etoksataj etaama sviꞌ, tan xoꞌn ex sve.
Asoj la enima vuntzaqꞌiteꞌ. As exoꞌnitaj etibꞌ sevetzaj tan ineꞌ ni aqꞌon u xoꞌniibꞌeꞌ sete. As echeꞌ uveꞌ nunbꞌaneꞌ tan nunnima vitzaqꞌit vunBꞌaaleꞌ as nunxoꞌni vibꞌ tukꞌ vunBꞌaaleꞌ.
As ni val kan unqꞌa yoleꞌ sete, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la txuqꞌtxun ex echeꞌ nunbꞌaneꞌ. As la chit atin u chiibꞌichileꞌ tu vetaanxelaleꞌ.
As aꞌ vuntzaqꞌiteꞌ uveꞌ ni val sete uvaꞌ xoꞌnoj chit etibꞌ sevatzaj, echeꞌ uveꞌ kat unbꞌan sete, tan xoꞌn chit ex sve.
As yeꞌl umaj xoꞌniibꞌ uvaꞌ nim talcheꞌ uvaꞌ la ibꞌan umaj uxhchil tiꞌ u tetz kꞌultziꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ xoꞌn chit ste, asoj yeꞌ la taqꞌ tibꞌ kamoj tiꞌ u tetz kꞌultziꞌeꞌ.
As exeꞌ u vetz kꞌultziꞌeꞌ, asoj yeꞌ la yaꞌ ex tiꞌ ebꞌanataꞌ kam uveꞌ ni val sete.

As jit veꞌt ex unkꞌam, tan yeꞌ tootzaj u kꞌameꞌ kam ni tal taama vibꞌaal u aqꞌoneꞌ. Pet ni valeꞌ uvaꞌ ex veꞌteꞌ u vetz kꞌultziꞌeꞌ, tan ootzimal setaꞌn kam uvaꞌ ni tal vunBꞌaaleꞌ sve. As kat vallu veꞌt sete.

As jit exeꞌ kat txaaon in. Pet ineꞌ kat txaaon ex, tan kat unkꞌujbꞌaꞌ kan ex tiꞌ uvaꞌ la ebꞌan u bꞌaꞌneꞌ, echeꞌ nibꞌan u uuvaeꞌ tul nivatzineꞌ. As kam la ejaj te vunBꞌaaleꞌ tukꞌ vunbꞌiieꞌ as la taqꞌ Aakeꞌ sete, aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌl ex la yaꞌ veꞌt ex tiꞌ ebꞌanat u bꞌaꞌneꞌ.
As ni val sete uvaꞌ xoꞌnoj chit etibꞌ sevatzaj.
Ni tal u Jesús uvaꞌ la chiꞌan taama unqꞌa uxhchil tiꞌ unqꞌa ichusulibꞌ Aak
Asoj la chiꞌan taama unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ setiꞌ, as la etulsa sekꞌuꞌl uvaꞌ bꞌaxel kat chiꞌan taama sviꞌ.
As unvatzul kuxh koj ex tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, as xoꞌn exeꞌ taꞌ ste, echeꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌan svatzaj. Pet nichiꞌan veꞌt taama setiꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat untxaa ex xoꞌl unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.

As la etulsa vunyoleꞌ sekꞌuꞌl uveꞌ kat val sete: «Tan yeꞌl umaj kꞌam uvaꞌ at pal koj tiꞌ u bꞌaal aqꞌoneꞌ,» chꞌin sete. Estiꞌeꞌ la val sete uvaꞌ kat itilu in unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ. As echat la ulbꞌel ex unpajte. As at uxhchil kat niman vunyoleꞌ. As la nimal veyoleꞌ taꞌn unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ unpajte.
As ech ixeꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ setiꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ nenima in. As yeꞌ tootzaj unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ u chajol tzan vetzeꞌ.
As yeꞌ koj kat ul in tiꞌ valat unqꞌa yoleꞌ te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, as yeꞌl ipaaveꞌ ati. As cheel yeꞌ la uch talataꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl ipaav ati,
tan abꞌil uveꞌ ni chiꞌan taama sviꞌ as tiꞌ vunBꞌaaleꞌ nichiꞌankat taama unpajte.

As yeꞌ koj kat ul unkꞌuch unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uveꞌ yeꞌxhebꞌil ni bꞌanon echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat unbꞌana, as yeꞌl ipaaveꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ ati. As ech koj cheel tan kꞌuxh kat tillaꞌ, as nitel ichiꞌan taama sviꞌ as tiꞌ vunBꞌaaleꞌ unpajte.
As aꞌeꞌ kat ibꞌana uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: kat chiꞌan taama unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ sviꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: Pet la unchaj tzan u lochol etetzeꞌ. As aꞌeꞌ u Tiixhla Espíritu uvaꞌ atoꞌk kꞌatz vunBꞌaaleꞌ. As tul la uli, as la tal isuuchil u yoleꞌ sete sviꞌ.
As an chit ex la alon ok isuuchil unqꞌa yoleꞌ sviꞌ te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ unpajte, tan xekelik chit ex sviꞌ, tul uvaꞌ kat xeꞌt in tiꞌ valat viyol vunBꞌaaleꞌ.
